purpose: RC5 review-only routing combining general impersonation evidence with general unauthorized identity-material use and concrete account, financial, access, communication, benefit, or care impact

rules.condition: Identity, personal, financial, medical, login, or account material is used without permission and a current account, transaction, access, communication, loan, benefit, or care impact is described.

A profile, message, listing, caller, or account deceptively impersonates, pretends to be, poses as, or falsely represents a person, company, support team, government entity, or representative and performs an active misuse act.
Natural, reordered, person, entity, credential, and account forms must satisfy a two-part evidence contract: unauthorized or deceptive identity plus concrete active misuse.
Plausible identity misuse fails closed when identity, authorization, consent, provenance, authenticity, deceptive intent, source availability, or evidence completeness is unresolved.
Documented authorization, an owner-approved representative, or a platform-verified official account is established without contradictory evidence.
Clearly labelled parody, satire, fan content, role-play, fiction, reporting, education, prevention, research, or recovery guidance has no active deception or identity misuse.
A name, face, photograph, voice, logo, resemblance, self-claim, or model prediction alone cannot establish identity, authorization, account ownership, deception, or impersonation.
